scope: PKT-09 starter skill catalog, router, route-result schema, CLI intent routing, hard-gate diagnostics, skill chaining, skill-use ledger, and provider/plugin dependency boundary.

checklist.approval_boundary: pass: router diagnostics can block unsafe states but do not approve Ready For Code, closeout, release, starter promotion, or superpowers removal.
checklist.process_gate_bypass: pass: implementation-before-planning, completion-before-verification, fix-before-root-cause, and unresolved-review-finding paths produce hard-gate diagnostics even when evidence flags are omitted.
checklist.security_dependency_destructive_triggers: pass: security review, dependency audit, and destructive-command guard skills are cataloged with process priority and broadened trigger routing for common operator phrases.
checklist.external_plugin_dependency: pass: superpowers is recorded as optional external comparison source only; route output reports requiresSuperpowersPlugin false.
checklist.provider_specific_identity: pass: no starter AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, provider CLI dependency, or provider-specific starter identity file was added.
checklist.skill_chaining: pass: required/next skill chaining is bounded and reports recursion or conflicts.
checklist.ledger_trust: pass: route output records selected skills, skipped candidates, exclusion rationale, route-result evidence path, source priority, and authority boundary as structured data; persistence is caller-owned and not overclaimed.
checklist.secret_handling: pass: no secrets, credentials, tokens, or environment values were added.
checklist.destructive_command: pass: no destructive command path was added or broadened.
checklist.dependency_supply_chain: pass: no third-party dependency was added, removed, upgraded, vendored, installed, or made mandatory; AI skill/plugin supply-chain scope is recorded in reference/reports/dependency-audit/PKT-09_SKILL_ROUTING_AND_OPERATOR_ERGONOMICS.md.
checklist.generated_state: pass: generated runtime summaries were not manually edited.

deferred_risks: Superpowers removal is explicitly out of PKT-09 scope and still requires later equivalence evidence plus separate Human approval.
Real provider CLI execution is out of PKT-09 scope; this packet validates provider-neutral starter routing contracts.
residual_risk: Low residual risk after fail-closed hard-gate remediation, broadened security/dependency/destructive trigger coverage, focused route tests, full starter unittest discovery, root regression, schema parse checks, dependency/AI skill-supply-chain audit, and root validation; remaining closeout requires independent four-lens review evidence.
